<!-- cli-reference:start — generated by `go run ./tools/sitecli` from the CLI; edit the command's help in the code, not this block -->

Build the technical changelog from the commits, release by release.

```text
This is the TECHNICAL changelog: every feat, fix and breaking change, in the commits' own
words, for whoever works on the code. It is not the product's release notes — for those,
have an agent synthesize a product changelog from this one (`anchors guide changelog`).

A release is what the history holds between two tags. Its commits, in Conventional
Commits, say what goes where:

  breaking changes   a `!` after the type, or a `BREAKING CHANGE:` footer
  features           feat
  bugs fixed         fix with a `Bug:` footer — a defect that shipped
  fixes              fix without it — a correction of work that never reached anyone

The other types (refactor, test, chore, …) are history, not changelog, and are left out.

By default the latest release is printed. `--from` takes every release after that tag,
`--all` every one, `--unreleased` adds what came after the last tag.

`--write` writes to the file the `changelog:` block of anchors.yaml names: in `incremental`
mode (the default) the releases the file does not hold yet go on its top, and what it holds
is kept as it is; in `per_version` mode each release gets its own file. The headings follow
the project's `lang`, and `changelog.template` replaces the built-in template.
```

## Usage

```bash
anchors changelog [flags]
```

## Flags

| Flag | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--all` |  | list every release |
| `--from` |  | list every release after this tag |
| `--root` | `.` | project root |
| `--to` | `HEAD` | the ref the history is read up to |
| `--unreleased` |  | also list what came after the last tag |
| `--write` |  | write to the file(s) `changelog:` names instead of printing |

## Changelog and pull requests — family

Commands of the same family — what tells each apart:

| Command | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| **`anchors changelog`** | Build the technical changelog from the commits, release by release |
| [`anchors commit-msg`](/docs/cli/commands/commit-msg/) | Confront the commit message with the format the changelog will read |
| [`anchors pr-body`](/docs/cli/commands/pr-body/) | Write the lines linking this work's cards, in the platform's syntax |
| [`anchors backfill-labels`](/docs/cli/commands/backfill-labels/) | Write into open issues the links the new version began to mark |
| [`anchors report`](/docs/cli/commands/report/) | Generate reports in docs/ by perspective (cuts of what Anchors measures) |
